title: RoleHear: Pseudo-Labeling for Semi-Supervised Role-Attributed Streaming Speech Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2610.33765v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Streaming automatic speech recognition transcribes at low latency but produces an unattributed word stream, while real-time applications such as customer-service analytics need each word tied to a speaker role. Role attribution is usually a separate stage, either an offline or streaming speaker-diarization model aligned to the words or a text-based large language model applied to the transcript, and role labels for training are scarce. We present RoleHear, a semi-supervised pipeline that makes a single cache-aware streaming transducer emit roles inline through lightweight in-vocabulary role tokens: a fast turn-boundary marker followed by a per-role token a few words later. An offline transducer teacher, fine-tuned into a role-attributed recognizer, relabels unlabeled audio, and a multimodal large language model supplies silver role labels where gold annotations are unavailable. translated_title: RoleHear：基于伪标签的半监督角色属性流式语音识别
translated_abstract: 流式自动语音识别（ASR）能够以低延迟进行转写，但产生的词流不带有说话人角色归属信息，而客服分析等实时应用需要将每个词与说话人角色关联起来。角色归属通常是一个独立的阶段，要么采用与词语对齐的离线或流式说话人日志模型，要么使用应用于转写文本的基于文本的大语言模型，且用于训练的角色标注数据十分稀缺。我们提出了RoleHear，一个半监督流水线，它使单一的缓存感知流式换能器（transducer）通过轻量的词表内角色标记内联输出角色：先是一个快速的轮次边界标记，随后在几个词之后输出一个按角色分配的标记。一个离线换能器教师模型经微调成为角色属性识别器后，对未标注音频进行重新标注，而一个多模态大语言模型在缺乏人工金标准标注的地方提供银级角色标签。流式学生模型在上述混合数据上进行微调。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: RoleHear提出一种半监督流水线，利用离线教师换能器和多模态大语言模型生成的伪标签，训练单个流式语音识别模型通过轻量词表内角色标记在转写的同时内联输出说话人角色。
en_tdlr: RoleHear is a semi-supervised pipeline that uses pseudo-labels from an offline teacher transducer and a multimodal LLM to train a single streaming ASR model to emit speaker roles inline via lightweight in-vocabulary role tokens.
